excluded_under_broadened_rubric_note: Rescreened all Brazil/LATAM-tagged listings across quality, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs (not just clinical ops/trial management) per the broadened rubric. Only additional candidates found were ClinChoice's Brazil-based Safety Officer, Drug Safety Associate, Medical Reviewer, and Regulatory Affairs Analyst roles — all titled 'Consultant' (contract) and/or junior-level, which score below 60 because they don't offer equal-or-better long-term pay/career growth vs. the candidate's current Portfolio Manager role. Also searched Brazilian-market employers directly on Gupy (Synvia, IDOR, Eurofarma, Rennova): excluded lab-technician/nursing/finance/QC/pre-clinical-R&D postings as out of scope, and excluded mid-level ('Pleno') and junior/broad-band postings (CRA all-levels, Monitor Sênior individual-contributor site-monitoring, Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios, Analista de Farmacovigilância Sr, Analista de Desenvolvimento Clínico Pleno) that score below 60 once compensation and seniority step-down from a portfolio-management role are weighed honestly. Rede D'Or's main 1,607-job board, Hospital Santa Lucinda, PUCRS, and Cristália/Hypera Pharma were checked and ruled out (wrong function or no current openings) in favor of IDOR (Rede D'Or's dedicated research institute). Checked three additional Brazilian-native job platforms (Catho, InfoJobs, Vagas.com) for a usable public API or structured feed like Gupy's: none exists -- all three are pure server-rendered HTML with no embedded JSON (no __NEXT_DATA__, no JobPosting JSON-LD, no genuine RSS/XML feed -- the .rss/.xml URL suffixes on Vagas.com just fall through to the same HTML page), so none were added as a provider; scraping raw HTML would be materially more fragile than every other provider in this pipeline and was deliberately not built. Added a 7th provider, Workday, after confirming a public unauthenticated JSON search API (wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs) for IQVIA, Parexel, Syneos Health, ICON plc, and Fortrea -- the major CROs previously missing entirely. Medpace (uses iCIMS, uscareers-medpace.icims.com) and PPD/Thermo Fisher clinical research (uses Phenom People, jobs.thermofisher.com) were confirmed NOT on Workday and are not covered by any provider in this pipeline. From ~303 Workday postings matched by searchText 'Brazil'/'LATAM' across the five companies, excluded the large majority as generic CRA/coordinator/associate-level individual-contributor roles (consistent with how plain CRA/Analista-level roles are scored elsewhere), out-of-function roles (software engineering, sales/commercial, legal, HR, logistics, translators), and a few Manager/Director-level roles that on closer inspection (job-detail location check) turned out to be Mexico-only remote, not actually Brazil-eligible (Syneos Health's Mgr/Sr Regulatory CMC Consultant, ICON's Medical Director (Endocrinology)) -- both excluded under the hard Brazil-workability requirement despite matching the LATAM text search. Added a Director/Country Manager 'stretch/leadership' search (tagged `tier: Stretch/Leadership` when found): confirmed working Gupy boards for Aché (vagasache.gupy.io) and Hypera Pharma (hyperapharma.gupy.io) and added both to fetch_gupy_jobs.py's COMPANIES (previously Hypera was checked once and deprioritized for lacking clinical-ops-relevant postings -- now tracked for leadership-level ones too); could not confirm a working Gupy subdomain for EMS Farmacêutica despite several guesses and secondary sources naming ems.gupy.io (genuine 404, not DNS failure -- possibly deactivated/migrated). Full title lists (not just keyword-filtered) for Aché, Hypera Pharma, and Eurofarma's Gupy boards were scanned for Director/Country Manager/VP-level titles: zero found. Checked LinkedIn and Indeed manually (both explicitly disallow job-search scraping in robots.txt, so no automated provider was built for either): one plausible-looking result (a 'Director, Clinical Operations' posting at Sun Pharma) turned out to be expired (404) when opened directly, confirming these platforms' search results can't be trusted as live without individual verification -- no LinkedIn/Indeed-sourced entries were added this round since nothing verifiably live and Brazil-relevant was found.
